summary: Joining procedures at EGHF amended, with base joins for runway 23 prohibited.
text:
JOINING PROCEDURES - BASE JOINS FOR RUNWAY 23 ARE PROHIBITED.
STANDARD JOIN FROM THE NORTH AMENDED:
FOR RUNWAY 05 - REMAIN WEST AND OUTSIDE FLEETLANDS ATZ THEN JOIN
DOWNWIND FOR RUNWAY 05. 
FOR RUNWAY 23 - ROUTE OVERHEAD WICKHAM VRP, MAINTAIN A SOUTHERLY
HEADING AND 2100 UNTIL OVERHEAD THE SOLENT, THEN DESCEND TO JOIN
DOWNWIND FOR RUNWAY 23.
UK AIP EGHF AD 2.22-2 REFERS.
